title: Sidebar
description: Fixed-position sidebar for app layouts with adjustable widths and positioning.

sections.title: Basic
sections.description: Default sidebar positioned on the start side. Use inside an app-shell layout.

sections.title: Widths
sections.description: Three width options via size modifiers.

examples.code:
<aside class="ui-sidebar ui-sidebar--sm">192px</aside>
<aside class="ui-sidebar ui-sidebar--md">240px (default)</aside>
<aside class="ui-sidebar ui-sidebar--lg">320px</aside>

sections.title: End Position
sections.description: Position sidebar on the end side with --end modifier.
